name: siftify
description: 100% offline macOS file & folder organizer powered by Apple Vision, PDFKit, Spotlight provenance, and local Apple Silicon Metal classifiers

scripts.app: bash scripts/build-app.sh && (pkill -x Siftify || true) && open build/Siftify.app
scripts.pro: bash scripts/build-pro-app.sh && (pkill -x SiftifyPro || true) && open build/SiftifyPro.app
